title: Venezuelan-Style Thai Fried Rice
description: A fusion of Thai and Venezuelan flavors in this easy-to-make fried rice dish.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic and stir-fry until the onion is translucent.
Add the sliced Thai red chili peppers and stir-fry for another minute.
Add the pilaf and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, breaking up any clumps.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet or wok and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, breaking up any clumps.
Add the Venezuelan cheese, fish sauce, soy sauce, and sesame oil to the rice mixture and stir-fry until the cheese is melted and the rice is well coated.
Transfer the rice mixture to a serving platter and garnish with additional Thai red chili peppers, if desired.
Note: You can customize this recipe by adding your favorite vegetables or protein to the rice mixture.
